purpose: Keyword-driven game environment concept images. Not an app-development task.
generation_reference_selection: Masters 01-04 v2.5: preserve the original 19 and add 5 scoped LDI architectural supplements (24 master images). Select a small role-labeled set; for a new scene balance composition/layout, architectural rendering and a Master04 world-design image before redundant style images or generated-result examples. M03-10 remains representative; select an additional scene-relevant LDI supplement when capacity allows. Consult docs/05_GENERATION_RULES.md for tool limits and scoped result reuse. M01/M02 govern basic geometry, mandatory single orthographic projection, perpendicular boundaries and continuous walking volumes. Compare final art to a scene-specific structure guide. M02 supplies functional direction/connectivity, not fixed gate locations; building ground footprints are orthogonal and roof planes are validated separately. The mandatory orthographic rule overrides every reference camera including M01; geometry references govern base/framing/connectivity; art and world references exclude their own camera/layout. A supplied guide is a visual cue, not a hard geometric constraint.
limits: Reference instructions guide image generation but do not guarantee geometry. Original master style/world must not be changed by interpreting a preferred example as replacement.
requested_scene_count_semantics: final_deliverables; structural correction attempts are preserved separately

structural_correction_policy.pass_gate: All applicable structural checks including mandatory final orthographic projection PASS; any FAIL => needs_revision; critical uncertainty => uncertain.
structural_correction_policy.global_geometry_fault_strategy: Rebuild common structure without preserving faulty geometry; zoom-out alone is not geometry correction.

scene_interpretation: New location keywords redesign building function, masses, layout, paving and subsurface infrastructure under unchanged spatial constraints; do not inherit prior scene-only props, weather or the same cutaway design. Explicit edits preserve the requested aspects of their target.

scoped_result_examples.allowed_use: Aspect-only comparison; vary actual infrastructure by location. No whole-image approval.
Relative visual presence only, no fixed percentage or exact buildings/devices. A new location must be redesigned.

geometry_policy.spatial_frame: single cubic virtual space with shared XYZ axes and scale
geometry_policy.default_base_footprint: square; shape exceptions require explicit user request
geometry_policy.base_geometry: four-corner plane extruded by consistent depth; corresponding vertical corners and planar front cuts
geometry_policy.rear_boundaries: two adjacent perpendicular back-boundary directions, expressed through buildings or other blocking objects; one functional exit per direction
geometry_policy.routes: reserve approach and post-clear/open-state passage volume to each transition; planned lock is distinct from accidental obstruction
geometry_policy.interior: when applicable, room depth and entry-to-functional-space circulation
workflow: Record mandatory single orthographic camera; shared-coordinate building footprints and separate roof/support plan
Check orthogonal polygon edges, base corners, grounding and route volumes; plan visible evidence
Assign two functional exit roles, positions, forms, states and post-clear connections
Compile requirement-covered prompt and transmit role-labeled guide/reference inputs
Inspect actual final image parallel same-world-axis line families, depth-invariant scale and constant-depth corner vectors under orthographic projection, then traversal and art
geometry_policy.building_footprints: common XY-axis orthogonal ground footprint and player-contact walls; L/T/U and right-angle setbacks permitted; no diagonal/chamfered/curved building traversal boundary
geometry_policy.prop_shape_exception: tanks/vehicles/props may be curved or rotated; same camera, grounding and clear exit routes required
geometry_policy.roof_geometry: varied roof profiles allowed; explicit plane/surface joins, wall-top alignment and supported equipment; uncertainty is not PASS
geometry_policy.reference_camera_priority: Mandatory orthographic projection overrides all reference cameras, including M01; preserve assigned structure/art/world roles.

rooftop.allowed: purposeful equipment, props or functional architectural elements with credible support and connections
rooftop.applies_to: buildings only; do not impose roof occupancy on tanks/vehicles

functional_exit_policy.position_per_side: center/intermediate/end, symmetric or asymmetric; no fixed coordinates or forced alternation
functional_exit_policy.state: record pre-clear locked or post-clear open; preserve approach, opening clearance and usable post-clear connection
functional_exit_policy.count_by: assigned traversal function, not visible door count

boundary_object_policy.requirements: readable blocking role along two rear directions; no unintended third route; protect center and designated exits

execution_prompt_policy.compile: Remove history and duplicate explanation; retain every applicable requirement through a coverage ledger. Do not append all master documents verbatim.
execution_prompt_policy.record: Exact submitted prompt, character/UTF-8 byte counts, actual reference paths/count/roles, confirmed tool contract and unknown limits separately.
execution_prompt_policy.independent_outputs: When the user requests independent variants, each starts from masters and its own scene plan; never feed one generated variant into the other.

geometry_review_policy.parallel_projection: Compare same-world-axis line families across base top/bottom, paving, building footings, wall tops and level roof edges. Corresponding top/bottom corner displacement vectors of a constant-depth base must agree. Equal actual lengths in the same 3D direction retain screen length at every depth.
geometry_review_policy.observations: Record native image dimensions, line endpoints, world-axis assignment, visibility, uncertainty and justified verdict; screen-angle differences are not measured 3D rotation.
geometry_review_policy.occlusion: Critical hidden footing/corner evidence remains UNCERTAIN. Prefer legible ground contacts when planning.
geometry_review_policy.exclude_false_matches: Do not compare sloped roofs, awnings, shadows or rotated/curved props as if they were level building-axis edges.
geometry_review_policy.reassessments: Preserve prior outputs and reviews; a new evidenced review supersedes a prior PASS. Failed or uncertain geometry is not a positive geometry reference.
geometry_review_policy.future_modeling: For exact geometry, separately retain a validated 3D blockout and camera as the authority. A 2D guide or coordinate JSON does not constrain the image generator as a geometry engine.
geometry_review_policy.perspective_result_policy: FAIL when perspective convergence or depth-based scaling contradicts orthographic projection, even if perspective is coherent; missing critical evidence is UNCERTAIN.

tool_input_evidence_policy.limits_source: Record the current tool contract. The documented maximum of 5 for num_last_images_to_include must not be transferred to referenced_image_paths.

latest_reassessments.role: diagnostic_only; supersedes prior candidate_pass without rewriting original records
